# BDSubMerge 1.0.2-beta.2

This prerelease improves dense table layouts and adds the first native Linux x86_64 package.

## Highlights

- Compact mapping columns now use only the width required for their complete headings and current
  values. The sequence heading is `No.`, and chapter, interval, offset, confidence, and status
  columns no longer reserve unnecessary space.
- Subtitle filenames and output target paths are never replaced with ellipses. Their columns retain
  the complete text and remain manually resizable, with horizontal scrolling when necessary.
- Simplified Chinese zero-time diagnostics now explain that an event shifted entirely before the
  final timeline cannot appear in the generated subtitle.
- Releases now include native Windows x64 ZIP and Linux x86_64 tar.gz packages, each with its own
  SHA-256 file. Linux packaging is built in parallel and tested under an X11 desktop environment.

## Validation

The release commit must pass Python 3.12 CI on Ubuntu and Windows. Both native packages must pass
version, license layout, checksum, no-system-Python GUI startup, and packaged screenshot gates before
the prerelease is created.

**Full Changelog**: [v1.0.2-beta.1...v1.0.2-beta.2](https://github.com/YuSaZh/BDSubMerge/compare/v1.0.2-beta.1...v1.0.2-beta.2)
